sources.publisher: AECID call resolution for the Africa-Med Master programme 2026-2027, as hosted by the Spanish embassy in Maputo
sources.note: Call text: up to 30 grants for official in-person master's degrees of at most 60 ECTS in Spain; the applicant must already hold admission to the master's; no list of master's or universities is attached
FAQ says admission to the master's is arranged by the applicant directly with the chosen university, separate from the grant application

subject_rule: Open: any official in-person university master's (up to 60 ECTS) at a Spanish university, in a field matching the applicant's academic or professional profile and the Spanish Cooperation priorities in the applicant's country. The call names no universities or master's programmes.
notes: No list of eligible universities or master's programmes exists in the call; applicants choose their own and need a 2026-2027 admission before applying. Scoring weighs the fit between the chosen master's, the applicant's job and Spanish Cooperation priorities.
